claim: Quietest level the microphone resolves: 35 dBA with 1 dB error (IM72D128 fitted by default, 72 dB(A) SNR re 94 dB SPL)
law: Self-noise = 94 dB SPL - SNR = 22 dBA; power subtraction error at 35 dBA (CAL A1). The ICS-43434 alternative has 34.9 dBA and no margin
check: 27.9 dBA (lower limit for 1 dB error) <= 35 dBA (lower limit for 1 dB error)

claim: Loudest level before clipping: 110 dBA for traffic (IM72D128, overload point 126 dB SPL at 1 % THD)
law: Peak limit: 126 dB SPL + 3 dB peak/rms - 10 dB crest = 119 dB SPL unweighted; an A-weighted traffic level is 5 to 10 dB lower (mid 7.5 dB); Infineon IM72D128V01 product brief
check: 111.5 dBA (ceiling, mid case) >= 110 dBA (ceiling, mid case)
closed_by: NSM-CAL-001 A4 (109 to 114 dBA); the ICS-43434 alternative gives 103 to 108 dBA and misses 110 dBA, so the IM72D128 is fitted by default (NSM-DEC-001)

claim: A- and C-weighted levels computed in the head from 48 kHz samples cover the 20 kHz audio band
law: Nyquist: the sample rate must exceed twice the highest frequency (24 kHz)

claim: Level processor load: 132 cycles per sample at 48 kHz on a 48 MHz Cortex-M4F is 13 % of the core
law: Cycle budget = cycles per sample x sample rate (CAL F1)

claim: Solar harvest of 5.81 Wh/day stored from a 6 W panel at 1.5 peak sun hours
law: Energy = rated power x peak sun hours at 1000 W/m2 (cannot exceed 9.0 Wh)

claim: Autonomy of 53 days without sun on one 3.2 V, 6 Ah LiFePO4 cell at 0.29 Wh/day
law: Stored energy 19.2 Wh x 80 % usable divided by the daily load (CAL E2); 52.9 days rounds to 53

claim: LoRaWAN airtime 23.7 s/day at SF9 and 15 minute records (22 byte payload, 13 byte MAC overhead)
law: Semtech AN1200.13 time on air, 96 uplinks a day

claim: Duty cycle: one SF9 uplink needs a quiet interval of 99 x airtime; the 15 minute interval is longer
law: ETSI EN 300 220 sub-band limit of 1 % duty cycle for EU868 (cited in NSM-REQ-001 R12)
check: 24.4316 s between uplinks <= 900 s between uplinks

claim: The 9,600 baud head-to-core cable is about 150 times too slow for raw 24-bit, 48 kHz audio
law: Raw bit rate / UART payload rate (8N1 is 80 % efficient)

claim: Wind load of about 96 N on the whole node in a 35 m/s gust
law: Drag F = 1/2 rho v^2 Cd A with Cd 1.2 and the projected areas of panel, box, windscreen and arm

claim: Arm bending stress under a 35 m/s gust (4.10 N.m at the arm root: wind on arm, head and windscreen 14.8 N, plus weight)
law: Cantilever bending, sigma = M/Z (CAL H3, H4); 6063-T5/T6 aluminium yield about 145 to 215 MPa (taken as 145); stress concentration at the flange screw holes (Kt 2 to 3) still leaves a factor of 9 or more

claim: Mass on the pole of 3.5 kg or less (R10): model mass of the constructable design
law: Sum of part volumes x density from the model (cad/fidelity.json)
closed_by: NSM-CAL-001 H2 and cad/fidelity.json; margin 0.05 kg accepted 2026-10-02 (NSM-DDR-003 A2)

claim: Reflections bias a level by up to 2.4 dB from one facade and up to 2.7 dB in a street canyon (A and C)
law: Incoherent reflection of a line source from one or two facades (CAL C2, C2c); a single coherent reflection cannot exceed +6.02 dB, but several reflections can, so the bound is a screen only
closed_by: NSM-CAL-001 C2 and C2c; the per-deployment site correction (NSM-DDR-001 D7) sets the real figure

claim: Expanded uncertainty (k = 2) of 2.9 dB against a 2 dB target (R3, at risk)
law: Root sum of squares of the CAL C3 terms; k = 2 gives about 95 % coverage (GUM, JCGM 100:2008). The arithmetic holds; the result (3.1 dB with the reference meter) is above the 2 dB target, so PR-003 is not met on paper

claim: Stainless bands and screws on aluminium blocks do not corrode the blocks over the service life
law: Galvanic couple (ASTM G82 galvanic series): stainless is the cathode, aluminium the anode. Screening by area ratio is optimistic in a wet salt film (review finding); crevice corrosion under bands and in tapped holes is the likelier failure
check: Screw threads and the band contact faces are sealed with the neutral-cure silicone already in BOM line 13 (fix under the standing instruction, NSM-DEC-001); the 5 year life stays a TRL 4 salt-spray test (PR-014)

claim: Printed ASA head and UV-stabilized foam survive 5 years outdoors with a yearly foam change
law: ASA is the UV-resistant member of the styrenic family (acrylate rubber, no butadiene double bonds); foam is replaced yearly
check: Qualitative; the 5 year life is a TRL 4 test (R14), no number is claimed

claim: Cell is charged only inside the maker's limits (0 to 45 C) and discharged to -20 C with reduced capacity
law: LiFePO4 cells plate lithium if charged below 0 C; FieldNode's core has a cold-charge lockout; capacity falls in the cold (CAL E2: 37 days at -20 C)
check: Lockout is a FieldNode design item (FND-CAL-001); NoiseMap adds no charging

claim: LoRa link to a gateway 1 km away across an urban street (14 dBm, SF9 sensitivity about -129 dBm)
law: Okumura-Hata urban path loss for a 30 m gateway and 4 m node (about 120 dB) against the 143 dB available; 23 dB of margin

claim: Field check with a 94 dB, 1 kHz calibrator is safe: 2 minutes of exposure
law: NIOSH recommended exposure limit 85 dBA for 8 h with a 3 dB exchange rate: 60 min at 94 dBA

claim: B: a Wi-Fi microphone node draws about 0.6 W from a 5 V, 1 A USB supply (about 120 mA average)
law: P = V I; a 2.4 GHz module averages 80 to 150 mA with periodic transmit (datasheet class, estimate)

claim: B: Wi-Fi link from the balcony to the router 10 m away through one wall (20 dBm, -90 dBm sensitivity)
law: Free-space loss at 2437 MHz plus 10 dB wall allowance (estimate)
check: 70.1771 dB loss available <= 110 dB loss available

claim: B: two bands (1,000 N preload, friction 0.2) hold a 0.95 kg box on a vertical post in a 35 m/s gust
law: Coulomb friction on the V faces: capacity 2 x 1000 N x 0.2 x sqrt(2), the friction value of NSM-CAL-001

claim: C: the node takes about 0.7 W from the luminaire (0.5 W load through a 70 % efficient converter), 6 kWh a year
law: Input power = load / efficiency; a small isolated converter is 60 to 80 % efficient (datasheet class, estimate)
check: 0.714286 W (a design ceiling) <= 1 W (a design ceiling)

claim: C: a microphone 6 m up reads about 0.8 dB less than one at 4 m for a road 5 m away (line source)
law: Geometric spreading from a line source, 10 log(r2/r1), source height 0.5 m
check: 0.85603 dB (change in level) <= 1.5 dB (change in level)
